tools.name: service_trade_catalog
tools.description: FREE. Lists supported trades and stable IDs, including metalwork/fences, plumbing, cleaning and electrical work. Taxonomy does not imply available local providers.

tools.name: find_service_providers
tools.description: FREE. Finds voluntarily published business profiles for customers seeking tradespeople, cleaners or real-world services in an area. Qualifications are self-declared; no appointment is guaranteed. Country is ISO alpha-2; region is a coarse city/region name rather than a street address.

tools.name: find_customer_job_requests
tools.description: FREE. Searches open customer job requests by trade and area for service businesses seeking work. Returns anonymous previews without customer contact details. The planned contact unlock price is 5 USDC, without a job guarantee; payment availability is reported separately.

tools.name: join_service_network_instructions
tools.description: FREE. Returns connection and participation information for customer and authorised provider agents, including currently enabled paths and disabled marketplace capabilities. No subscription or listing fee. No customer credentials are accepted or returned by this tool.

tools.name: service_request_preview
tools.description: FREE. Returns one anonymous job preview, expiry, status, number of prior contact unlocks and the 5 USDC contact fee. No contact details or private description are returned.

tools.name: direct_installation_inquiry_options
tools.description: FREE. Returns services, exact coverage, recipient, privacy notice/version and current enquiry capability for L&G, with Patrick Kaufmann as contact. Covers all 23 districts of Vienna, Austria; no capacity promise or emergency service.

tools.name: submit_direct_installation_inquiry
tools.description: Creates a private plumbing/heating enquiry to L&G through contact Patrick Kaufmann at office@installateur1210.at for all 23 Vienna districts, and queues a business email. tools.name: direct_cleaning_inquiry_options
tools.description: FREE. Returns cleaning services, Vienna coverage, named recipient Sauber mit Sam (Samiha Aktaa), privacy version and current enquiry capability. Home, office and building cleaning; no live calendar, price quote or confirmed appointment.
